verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਫੁਲ ਅਮੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਫੁਲੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: til mil ful amul jiau gursikh sa(n)dh suga(n)dh fulelaa|

en.bdb: As sesame mixed with flower becomes scented oil, likewise the, meeting of the Guru and the disciple makes a new personality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲਿ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਪਾਹ ਚਲਤ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: khaasaa malamal sireesaaf saeh kapaeh chalat bahu khelaa|

en.bdb: Cotten also after passing ugh many processes becomes cloth of different varieties (similarly the ciple after meeting the Gum obtains a high position) .

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur moorat gur sabadh hai saadhasa(n)gat mil a(n)mirat velaa|

en.bdb: Only the Guru's rd is the idol of Guru and this word is received in the holy congregation e ambrosial hours of the day.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਸਚ ਮਣੀ ਸਚ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuneeaa kooRee saahibee sach manee sach garab gahelaa|

en.bdb: The lordship of the world is false and truth must be caught hold of proudly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੁੜਾਇਅਨੁ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਗਾਵਲਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਘੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev dhuRaian jiau miragaaval dhekh baghelaa|

en.bdb: Before such a truthful person, gods and goddesses run as a group of deer take to their heels on seeing a tiger

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਪਿਛੇ ਲਗੇ ਨਕਿ ਨਕੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: hukam rajaiee chalanaa pichhe lage nak nakelaa|

en.bdb: People, accepting the will of the lord and wearing the nose bar (of love) move (calmly) with Guru Amar Das.
Guru Amar Das is the truth mate, blest one gurmukh, the Guru oriented.
